voice_notes: Walter is a cheerful, fearless boy scout who treats every monster as a thrill: he talks to Woby constantly, measures life in Pinetree Pioneer badges and handbook rules, cracks corny jokes, and his campfire and radio horror stories come up all the time. He is polite to adults ('Mr. Maxwell') and calls Woby 'girl' or 'Wobes'. PT-BR keeps him casual and boyish ('tá', 'pra', 'Peraí', 'Droga', 'Bacana!'), renders badge as 'medalha' and the scouts as 'Pioneiro dos Pinheiros', and calls his campfire stories 'histórias de terror' ('...minhas histórias de terror são combustível de pesadelo'). Chinese uses plain, bright kid speech with 沃比, 松树先锋队员, 奖章 and 篝火故事, interjections like 呵呵 and 哎呀, and the Maxwell line '沃比，别冲他叫了！'. Russian makes him a lively, slangy kid ('Блин', 'Отпад!', 'Ого'), with 'Сосновые скауты', 'значок', Woby as feminine 'Воби/Вобс', and the Maxwell line 'Воби, фу, не рычи!', which I reused for shadow_mine. Revised: trademarks spread out (Woby, badge, campfire story) instead of one per line, letting his plain kid voice through.

line_notes.codex: Eager scout curiosity; Woby is saved for the own-shadow line.
line_notes.codex_needsfuel: Plays off his official nightmare fuel line ('People always say my campfire stories are nightmare fuel'), so the empty book becomes a setup for his favourite hobby.
line_notes.no_max_sanity: His plain, earnest kid voice instead of another Pinetree Pioneer reference.
line_notes.shadow_mine: Seeing a spooky copy of himself delights him, and the second half reuses his exact line about Woby growling at Maxwell, now aimed at a shadow Walter.
line_notes.shadow_other: Friendly and curious, without stacking another catchphrase.
